name: PReLUPerChannelQ7
adaptation: Apply PReLU to four pixels with four signed INT8 channels each, packed pixel-major. Channel c has its own unsigned 8-bit slope A[c]/128. For X>=0 return X. For X<0, round X*A[c]/128 to nearest integer with ties away from zero, then saturate to [-128,127]. The same four supplied slopes apply to every pixel. This retains PReLU sign selection and channel broadcasting; Q1.7 slopes, signed-byte saturation and explicit rounding replace source floating-point arithmetic.
